001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service;
002
003import androidx.core.content.FileProvider;
004import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.R;
005
006/**
007 * A specialized implementation of {@link FileProvider} for managing access to image files within
008 * the app. This class extends the functionality of {@code FileProvider} by providing file path
009 * mappings defined in the `provider_paths` resource.
010 *
011 * This class is primarily used to securely grant access to image files stored in the app's private
012 * storage to other components or applications, for example, when sharing images via intents.
013 *
014 * Note: This class uses the {@code R.xml.provider_paths} file to define URI mappings for secure
015 * file sharing.
016 */
017public class ImageFileProvider extends FileProvider {
018
019  public ImageFileProvider() {
020    super(R.xml.provider_paths); // Initialize with our provider-path mapping
021  }
022
023}
